units.source_text: 今天中途暂停，名人一回到自己的房间里，马上同小野田六段下起将棋来，实在令人吃惊。

en.t: Today, when play was suspended midway, the Master returned to his room and immediately began playing shogi with Onoda Sixth Dan, which was truly astonishing.

units.source_text: 据说下完将棋，又搓麻将。

en.t: It is said that after finishing the shogi game, he went on to play mahjong.
